content:
We've been on iOS 27 for about two months now. Of course, it's a beta — the final version is still around four to six weeks away. That said, even though I've been running the beta on my own phone for the past two months, I can't say I've particularly noticed it being there. It just... works really smoothly.

Of course, I still look forward to opening up the software update screen every few weeks or so to install the latest beta. That's the one constant of the entire iOS 27 beta experience.

Otherwise, I can't name a single one of those complaints people generally mention when talking about betas. Basically no abnormal battery drain, no overheating, no weird lag, no random crashing.

You get all the benefits of the new system with iOS 27 — Siri artificial intelligence (AI), AirPods EQ equaliser, new digital wallet tickets in Safari, beefier AI photo editing and more — without any of the usual side effects of running the most cutting-edge test software. Honestly, that's pretty remarkable.

iOS 26 itself wasn't exactly stable to begin with, which might be part of the reason. Particularly iOS 26.5 somehow (for me at least) caused my phone to start respringing constantly.

These are all anecdotal of course, but ask anyone and you'll hear some stories about iOS 26 misbehaving.

iOS 27 delivers in spades

That said, when it comes to speed improvements, bug fixes, stability and quality of life improvements, iOS 27 really does deliver impressively. You might not notice it at first because Siri AI is doing a lot of background indexing work — though Apple has recently rolled out iOS 26.6 which kicks off the Siri AI indexing in the background, so when you upgrade to iOS 27 you won't have to wait for that. Once you get past that step, it's smooth sailing.

I'm really looking forward to regular users getting to experience iOS 27 for themselves when the final version rolls out next month. It sounds hard to believe, but it really does feel like Apple has solved all the major iOS annoyances. Of course, it's not perfect — software never is — but it's definitely the best iPhone experience I can remember.

iOS 27 will support every iPhone model that ever supported iOS 26, meaning iPhone 11 and later will all receive the update.

My favourite Apple accessory recommendations:

  • Anker MagSafe/Qi2 ultra-slim external charger
  • AirPods Pro 3 (twice the active noise cancellation performance of AirPods Pro 2!)
  • Anker Nano 45W fast charger (with smart display)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 MacBook dock
  • Logitech MX Master 4 Mac mouse
  • Belkin Qi2 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand
